transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "A Study of KIVU-107 in Participants With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors". Your earlier answers already covered 2 of its rules. I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you 18 years of age or older?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, dear, I'm eighty.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you been told that there is no standard treatment with proven effectiveness available for your specific type of tumor?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm not sure about that. You'd have to ask my neighbor, I don't remember the details.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you had recent blood tests (like a CBC, kidney panel, and liver function tests) that showed your bone marrow, kidney, and liver are working well?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm not sure about that. You'd have to ask my neighbor, I don't remember the details.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you had any recent scans (like CT or MRI) that showed your tumor is large enough to be measured?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm not sure, you'd have to ask my neighbor.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Based on your current health, do you expect to live for at least 3 more months? It's okay if you're not sure.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I hope so, dear. I'm up for more than half the day, but I can't do any work and I sit a lot.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To help us understand better, do you feel healthy enough to expect to live for at least 3 more months? It's okay if you're not sure.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I hope so, dear. I'm up for more than half the day, but I can't do any work and I sit a lot.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever received a treatment called an ADC (antibody-drug conjugate) that uses a topoisomerase 1 inhibitor as its payload? It's okay if you're not sure.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I'm not sure, you'd have to ask my neighbor.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever received any treatment specifically targeting a protein called PTK7? It's okay if you're not sure.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know what that is, dear. You'd have to ask my neighbor.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you have any heart or blood vessel conditions that are not well-controlled, such as recent heart attack, unstable angina, or severe heart failure?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't had a heart attack or heart failure that needed hospital care recently.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Aside from those, do you have any other heart or blood vessel conditions that are not well-controlled, such as unstable angina?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know about unstable angina, dear. You'd have to ask my neighbor.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been diagnosed with Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, or HIV?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I don't have HIV. I don't know about the hepatitis ones, dear.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been diagnosed with interstitial lung disease? This is a condition that causes scarring in the lungs. If you aren't sure, that's okay.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Inflammation? Maybe, I don't recall.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To clarify, have you ever been told by a doctor that you have a lung condition involving scarring or inflammation of the lung tissue (interstitial lung disease)?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't remember, dear. You'd have to ask my neighbor.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you had any major surgery, radiation therapy, or systemic anti-cancer treatment in the last 3 weeks?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I had radiation on my chest in the summer, about two months ago, so I don't think it was in the last three weeks. I don't remember any other treatments recently.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's all my questions. Your record for this trial is ready, for you and your oncologist. They and the trial team decide whether it is right for you.
